apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: recommendationservice
  namespace: boutique
  labels:
    app: recommendationservice
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: recommendationservice
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: recommendationservice
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: recommendationservice
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 5
      securityContext:
        fsGroup: 1000
        runAsGroup: 1000
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
      imagePullSecrets:
      - name: non-existent-secret
      containers:
      - name: server

          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
              - ALL
          privileged: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
        image: ghcr.io/testuser177/solar-system:latest
        ports:
        - containerPort: 8080
        readinessProbe:
          initialDelaySeconds: 5
          periodSeconds: 5
          grpc:
            port: 8080
        livenessProbe:
          initialDelaySeconds: 5
          periodSeconds: 5
          grpc:
            port: 8080
        env:
        - name: PORT
          value: "8080"
        - name: PRODUCT_CATALOG_SERVICE_ADDR
          value: "productcatalogservice:3550"
        - name: DISABLE_PROFILER
          value: "1"
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 100m
            memory: 220Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 450Mi

  namespace: boutique
